summary: KB Financial Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing its board's designation of August 7, 2026 as the record date for interim (quarterly) cash dividends for the second quarter of 2026. Shareholders entitled to dividends are determined solely based on the record date, with no closure of the shareholders registry. The filing references Article 60 of the company's articles of incorporation authorizing quarterly dividend distributions pursuant to board resolutions within 45 days of the end of March, June, or September. This is a routine dividend record date notice, not a special situation.
